headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 3, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Baltimore Orioles, securing an 8-0 victory. Tim Mayza earned the win after 2.0 IP of relief work, striking out 3 batters without allowing an earned run. In other action, the St. Louis Cardinals took down the Toronto Blue Jays 5-1, with Jordan Walker leading the offense.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with PJ Poulin of the Washington Nationals being transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a left flexor strain. Jake Fraley of the Tampa Bay Rays has been placed on the 60-day injured list with a hernia, while Lenyn Sosa of the Toronto Blue Jays has been placed on the 60-day injured list with a right wrist contusion.

The Colorado Rockies have made a trade, acquiring shortstop Carlos Vielma from the Chicago White Sox in exchange for center fielder Brenton Doyle. The Toronto Blue Jays have also made a trade, acquiring Josh Smith and Josh Stephan from the Texas Rangers in exchange for left-hander Adam Macko.

top_news.title: **Phillies Shut Out Orioles 8-0**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Baltimore Orioles, securing an 8-0 victory. Tim Mayza earned the win after 2.0 IP of relief work, striking out 3 batters without allowing an earned run.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall Short in Atlanta**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dropped a 2-4 decision to the Atlanta Braves, unable to overcome a strong Braves performance. Mike Yastrzemski led the Nationals' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Take Down Blue Jays 5-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a 5-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Jordan Walker leading the offense. Walker collected 2 hits, 2 RBIs, and was instrumental in a key play that saw Blaze Jordan and Lars Nootbaar score.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Fall to Guardians in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians dominated the Arizona Diamondbacks 5-0, securing a shutout victory. Patrick Bailey led the Diamondbacks with a home run and an RBI, while Gavin Williams pitched 5.2 innings of scoreless baseball, striking out 10 batters.

top_news.title: **Nationals' PJ Poulin Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Washington Nationals left-handed pitcher PJ Poulin has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a left flexor strain.

top_news.title: **Rockies Acquire Carlos Vielma in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies have acquired shortstop Carlos Vielma in a trade with the Chicago White Sox. In exchange, the Rockies sent center fielder Brenton Doyle to the White Sox.
